reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, matching the preferred position's basis and floor.

21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and 21.3 places confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP outside the cap — the full preferred carve-out set — and confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligations are not capped 'damages'.
The 'Fees' definition (1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the fee limb is not illusory; the USD 1,000,000 floor independently guarantees a meaningful cap.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs, and both deterministic checks pass; no competing one-sided limit was identified in warranty/indemnity/insurance provisions.
